The Authorization header is parsed by splitting on a single space and rejected with 403 if the prefix does not match.
The Authorization header scheme defaults to the word Token instead of Bearer.
A separate per-user salt is stored in its own column and prepended to the password before hashing.
Passwords are hashed with bcrypt through a passlib CryptContext.
Updating an article title regenerates its slug, so the article URL changes.
An article slug is derived from its title with python-slugify.
